```{r}
#| include: true
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
```

# Caracterización de fuentes sísmicas {#sec-ssc}

## Marco sismotectónico

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(
  path   = sprintf("/_chapters/ssm.tectonic.%s.es.md", params$ssm),
  stem   = sprintf("ssm-tectonic-%s", tolower(params$ssm)),
  labels = "keep",
  root   = root
)
```

## Modelo regional de fuentes (SSM) {#sec-ssm}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(params$ssm) || !nzchar(params$ssm)) {
  stop("params.yml: params$ssm must name the seismic source model chapter (_chapters/ssm.<ID>.es.md).", call. = FALSE)
}
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = sprintf("/_chapters/ssm.%s.es.md", params$ssm),
  stem = sprintf("ssm-%s", tolower(params$ssm)),
  labels = "keep",
  root = root
)
```
